## Problem

The `ansi`, `base16`, and `base16-256` syntax themes are designed to emit ANSI palette colors so that highlighted code respects the user's terminal color scheme. Syntect encodes this intent in the alpha channel of its `Color` struct — a convention shared with `bat` — but `convert_style` was ignoring it entirely, treating every foreground color as raw RGB. This caused ANSI-family themes to produce hard-coded RGB values (e.g. `Rgb(0x02, 0, 0)` instead of `Green`), defeating their purpo
